segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the email on the account?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, it’s Daniel at Northstar Fabrication. Email is daniel.cho@northstarfab.com. I’m trying to add a few user seats before our training on Monday.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I’ve got Northstar Fabrication pulled up in the admin console. You’re currently on 42 seats, renewal date is October 31, 2026. How many would you like to add?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Five, please. So 47 total. And I just want to make sure billing doesn’t get weird, like it’s prorated for the current term?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, exactly. I’m checking the billing tool now. Five additional seats at your current rate comes to $318.75 prorated through October 31. That will appear on invoice 78144, generated today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that works. Can you go ahead and add them?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. Your seat count is now 47. I also refreshed the license allocation, so your admin should be able to invite those users right away.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Is there anything I need to do for the invoice, or will it go to accounting?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: It’ll go to billing@northstarfab.com, same as your prior invoices. I’m also sending you a copy of the receipt and the seat change confirmation. Ticket number is 246913.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that’s all I needed. Thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. Have a good one.
